name: VRM_REVENUE_ASSIGNMENTS_GT
description: VRM_REVENUE_ASSIGNMENTS_GT is a global temporary table used while processing return or version lines.

columns.name: COMPLETE_FLAG
columns.description: A flag that indicates if a revenue document is completed.

columns.name: ACCOUNT_CLASS
columns.description: Account class associated with the revenue adjustment schedule line account code.

columns.name: LUMP_SUM_FLAG
columns.description: A flag derived from type of rule which is used for internal processing.

columns.name: RULE_TYPE
columns.description: Rule type assigned to the revenue line. Values are from the lookup RULE_TYPE.

columns.name: PERCENT
columns.description: Percent of the line amount to be recognized on a specified accounting date.

columns.name: RULE_DATE
columns.description: Date on which to recognize revenue.

columns.name: PERIOD_TYPE
columns.description: Accounting period type. Examples are Weekly, Monthly, Quarterly.

columns.name: MAX_REGULAR_PERIOD_LENGTH
columns.description: Maximum number of days in a period within this period type.

columns.name: PPRR_AMOUNT
columns.description: Used by rules for processing the partial amounts.
